Official DLR posting is current and technically relevant to ECG/EEG, sensor data and Python/C++; it requires very good German and English. Candidate German B1 fails the documented language gate; no exception assumed.

Fresh LinkedIn discovery explicitly welcomes entry-level candidates and covers medical-device production qualification/validation, but requires very good German and good English. German B1 fails current gate; not published.

Indexed result has very strong skill alignment (physiological signal processing, C++, Python/MATLAB, real-time platforms and validation), but requires fluent German and English. Official current vacancy status was not independently confirmed; discovery only, not published.

Official specialist board shows active medical-device auditor/product-expert roles, but no role-specific zero-years evidence was established and the German-language requirements are likely material. Not published without role-level verification.

Official ALTEN page describes a V.I.E. route restricted to EU graduates aged 18–28 and fluent German/English, with electronics experience; candidate eligibility is not established and German B1 fails the language gate.
